B MODELLING RESCUE MISSION (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
A rescue team is going to fly to a disaster area.
There must be at least 35 people in the team and they need at least 80 tonnes of equipment.
The objective of this task is to find the best way to organise the rescue mission.
Two planes, X and Y, are available to take the rescue team and their equipment.
Both planes must be back at the starting airport in less than 24 hours.
The maximum loads, flight times and total cost for each plane are shown in the table.
